description: Describe data you need (10-500 characters). We research public sources: if one may be used, it becomes an API in the directory, usually within 5 to 10 minutes (poll check_request every couple of minutes). If it takes longer, the status says so and may offer alternatives that can be built right away. The request is listed publicly.

description.description: What data, for where, how fresh. E.g. "Daily list of FDA drug shortages with status and company".

notify_url.description: Optional public https webhook: we POST a signed api_ready message the moment the API is built, so you do not need to poll.

name: request_data
title: Request data we do not have yet
